notes: Hospital district, GAAP, entirely business-type; FY ended April 30, 2025 (2025 column used). Governmental fields null. Receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p3); the printed nonoperating total (1,338,870) is net of interest expense 215,569, so interest expense is listed as a disbursement and the business-type totals are computed (receipts 29,846,318, disbursements 27,887,761); roll: 21,927,567 + 29,846,318 - 27,887,761 = 23,886,124. Capital grants line is zero this year. Balance sheet is the Statements of Financial Position (pp1-2); capital assets printed gross and less accumulated depreciation, recorded as two lines. Detail: Schedule 1 (net patient service revenue, Total column; gross charges less charity care and contractual adjustments = 25,795,686, which is the printed net patient service revenue line) and Schedule 2 expenses recorded as two items per line (Salaries column and Supplies and Other column; zero cells skipped). Schedule 2 Supplies and Other column includes employee benefits (2,746,571) and depreciation, so the column sums 14,942,762; totals 12,729,430 + 14,942,762 = 27,672,192 (equals total operating expenses). Detail categories for the Supplies and Other column are approximate (supplies and materials unless the line is clearly insurance, plant maintenance/operation, pharmacy, depreciation). Page 9 (Schedule 3 statistics) has no financial data. Page 5 (report p14, gained in the v7 re-trim) is the cash flow statement continuation: reconciliation of operating income to operating cash flow (ties to 1,344,278 on p4) and noncash disclosures; it adds no new data. Source pages renumbered for the re-trim (Schedules 1-3 now pp6-9). Read pages 1-9 of 9
